Name: Force ID
notes: Unique army id and map-token id. Never reuse. Future named characters attach to this id. There is no separate fleet_id.

Name: Owner
notes: Person who fields this army. One player may have many forces; each is its own token on the map.

Name: Force Name
notes: Public name on the map and in battle reports. This replaced fleet_name.

Name: Game System
notes: HH = Age of Darkness 28mm. AT = Adeptus Titanicus. AI = Aeronautica Imperialis. LI = Legions Imperialis. A Titanicus army is a separate force (and a separate map token) from 28mm titan support.

Name: Force Type
type: enum (Legion, Solar Auxilia, Mechanicum, Dark Mechanicum, Questoris, Legio Titanicus, Custodes, Silent Sisterhood, Militia, Blackshields, Daemons, Knights-Errant)
notes: What the army is. Not the player.

Name: Allegiance
notes: Army allegiance. May differ from the player (Shattered Legions, Blackshields).

Name: Legion
type: enum (I Dark Angels, III Emperor's Children, IV Iron Warriors, V White Scars, VI Space Wolves, VII Imperial Fists, VIII Night Lords, IX Blood Angels, X Iron Hands, XII World Eaters, XIII Ultramarines, XIV Death Guard, XV Thousand Sons, XVI Sons of Horus, XVII Word Bearers, XVIII Salamanders, XIX Raven Guard, XX Alpha Legion)
notes: Required when force_type is Legion. Omit II and XI unless the campaign allows Lost Legions. For Blackshields, leave empty or record suspected origin.

Name: Subfaction
notes: House name (Questoris), Legio name (Titanicus), cohort (Auxilia), taghmata / forge world (Mechanicum).

Name: Unique Allies
type: array of enum (Custodes, Silent Sisterhood, Daemons, Knights-Errant)
notes: Comma-separated. Empty means none. Regular allies (other Legions, Auxilia, Knights, Mechanicum) are not unique and do not belong here.

Name: Organisation
notes: Rite of War (HH), maniple (AT), formation (LI), or wing (AI).

Name: Warlord Name
notes: Display label only, not an entity. Do not encode death, wounds, or relics here. A future db_characters sheet would add warlord_id as an FK beside this label.

Name: Primarch Present
notes: List-building flag only (does this army include a Primarch). Not a character record.

Name: Titan Support 28mm
notes: HH only: can field Legio Titanicus as Lords of War. Not the same as an AT force token.

Name: Typical Points
notes: Usual list size. Actual game size is recorded on db_games.points.

Name: Home System
notes: Origin / recruitment base. Distinct from current map position (sys_id).

Name: Location
notes: Current campaign-map position. Who is in a system is derived from this column. When status is in_warp, this is the system just left.

Name: Destination
notes: Movement order. Must be empty or a warp-linked neighbour of Location. Required when status is in_warp. Clear on arrival.

Name: Strength
notes: Map combat power of this token. Suggested range 1-10. Separate from tabletop points.

Name: Status
type: enum (active, damaged, in_warp, refitting, rebuilding, destroyed, retired)
notes: Map and campaign status of the token. active/damaged/refitting = in Location. in_warp = moving to Destination. destroyed/retired keep the row for history. This is army status, not warlord status.

Name: Notes
example: Siege cadre. Flagship damaged at Mezoa.
notes: Army-level lore and map notes. Named-character wounds, death, and relics do not belong here.
